url.description: Private merchant setup capability in a fragment; never log or share publicly.

claimUrl.description: Private merchant capability in a fragment; never log or share publicly.

ProblemCode.description:
The closed set. `method_not_allowed` (405, with `Allow`) answers a
known path with the wrong method. Shared writes return intent/state
conflicts according to their owner. `verification_failed` (422) also
identifies retained customer evidence that cannot establish an opt-in.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `policyId` and `errors` are always present, `null` outside their one case.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

key.description: Direct API-key metadata; null for an approved installation delegation.

expiresAt.description: When this key stops working (earlier than its lifetime once it has been rotated).

totalMinor.description: Amount in the currency's minor unit (paise for INR), as a decimal string.

href.description: The `/v1` path to read the resource at.

DeveloperChangedEventEnvelope.description: Identifiers only. Never message text, names, phone numbers or amounts.

MessageDeliveryChangedEventEnvelope.description:
Thin v1 observation of committed provider delivery facts, separate from
operation progress. Read the current message using messages.read.
Duplicate callbacks do not produce new events; recovery can coalesce
several pending changes to their latest retained state.

OperationChangedEventEnvelope.description:
Opt-in v2 observation of retained operation progress. Thin identifiers
only, without message content or delivery claims. Existing resource
events retain v1. Use your bound client's operations.get(resource.id);
an event grants no read authority over another producer's operations.

ApplicationResourceEventEnvelope.description: Thin v2 event for an application receiver, attributed to the original approved merchant installation.

EndpointTestEventEnvelope.description: Sent only when you press Send test for one endpoint. Carries no workspace data.
